nodes.label: Modified Pi-Rating System
nodes.author: Anthony C. Constantinou
nodes.rationale: Omits diminishing goal difference function psi(e) to optimise directly for goal difference rather than win outcome, and introduces multiplier k=3 for rapid convergence on teams with under 38 matches.

nodes.author: Anthony C. Constantinou
nodes.norm_label: hybrid bayesian network for asian handicap (constantinou)
nodes.rationale: Simulates influential causal dependencies from possession to shots, shots on target, and goals using modified pi-ratings as inputs to assess Asian Handicap market efficiency.

nodes.norm_label: the betting odds rating system (bors / elo-odds)
nodes.rationale: Combines Elo rating framework with odds-derived pre-match expectations instead of actual match results, demonstrating that pre-match odds contain more informative signal than the observed result itself.

nodes.label: Goto Conversion Repository

nodes.rationale: Open-source implementation of OO-EPC used widely across competitive forecasting solutions.

nodes.label: Shin's Normalisation Method
nodes.author: H. S. Shin
nodes.rationale: Accounts for insider trading rates in betting markets to extract true underlying outcome probabilities from bookmaker odds.

nodes.label: Hierarchical Bayesian Poisson Model (Egidi et al.)
nodes.author: Leonardo Egidi et al.
nodes.norm_label: hierarchical bayesian poisson model (egidi et al.)
nodes.rationale: Combines historical match scores and implicit scoring rates from bookmakers' odds via a convex combination to enrich football prediction.

nodes.label: Combining Historical Data and Bookmakers' Odds (Egidi et al.)
nodes.author: Leonardo Egidi, Francesco Pauli, Nicola Torelli
nodes.norm_label: combining historical data and bookmakers' odds (egidi et al.)
nodes.rationale: Develops a hierarchical Bayesian Poisson model blending historical goal parameters with implicit bookmaker scoring intensities.

nodes.label: Beating the Bookies with Their Own Numbers
nodes.author: Lisandro Kaunitz, Shenjun Zhong, Javier Kreiner
nodes.norm_label: beating the bookies with their own numbers
nodes.rationale: Exploits aggregate consensus odds across bookmakers as a proxy for true underlying outcome probabilities to discover mispriced odds rather than competing with bookmaker predictive models directly.

nodes.label: PlayeRank Framework (Pappalardo et al.)
nodes.author: Luca Pappalardo et al.
nodes.rationale: Multi-dimensional and role-aware data-driven evaluation framework of soccer player performance quality.

nodes.label: A Public Data Set of Spatio-temporal Match Events in Soccer Competitions

nodes.norm_label: bayesian network classifiers for fouls and draws (perez-blanco & salmeron)
nodes.rationale: Proposes class-separating discretization strategies for Naive Bayes to handle ordinal fouls and imbalanced draw events.

nodes.label: The Evolution of Football Betting: ML Forecasting (Mandadapu)
nodes.author: Purnachandra Mandadapu
nodes.norm_label: the evolution of football betting: ml forecasting (mandadapu)
nodes.rationale: Examines ML models (SVM, RF, KNN, XGB) and feature engineering (xG, xGA, SCA, GCA, RFE) for 1x2 match outcome betting.

nodes.label: Football Quantitative Betting & Prediction Guide
nodes.rationale: Data-first quantitative framework strictly ruling out gambling subjectivity with the sole axiom that bookmakers always aim for maximum profit.

nodes.label: 1x2 Bet Odds & Overround
nodes.rationale: Bookmaker odds formulation accounting for implied event probability plus vigorish/overround to ensure bookmaker margins.

nodes.label: Ranked Probability Score (RPS)
nodes.rationale: Evaluation metric that measures discrepancies across cumulative probability distributions, penalizing distant errors in ordinal classification.

nodes.label: Relative Distance to Adjacent Centroids Discretization
nodes.norm_label: relative distance to adjacent centroids discretization
nodes.rationale: Assigns soft membership weights to adjacent cluster centroids to capture team heterogeneity without blurring ordinal structures.

nodes.label: Shin's Insider Trading Model
nodes.rationale: Calculates true unrigged match probabilities and insider incidence parameter z by root-finding inversion over fractional odds.

nodes.label: Weighted Accuracy (WAP) and Weighted Recall (WAR)
nodes.rationale: Metrics incorporating inverse class frequency weights and dynamic historical draw thresholds to counter severe class imbalance.

nodes.label: Literature Index & Methodology Map
nodes.rationale: Provides taxonomic organization across odds-inversion, draw/foul physics mechanisms, and micro-event player analytics.

nodes.rationale: Mathematical analysis of non-symmetric bookmaker margin removal, distinguishing uniform take from insider trading risk z.

nodes.label: Skellam Distribution Formulation
nodes.rationale: Under Poisson conditional independence of match scores, goal difference follows a Skellam (Poisson-Difference) distribution, enabling extraction of implicit scoring intensities from odds.

nodes.label: Dynamic Seasonal Team Effects
nodes.rationale: Attack and defence strengths are assumed dynamic across seasons following a Normal distribution centred at previous season effects plus fixed drift, avoiding static limitations.

nodes.label: Betting Efficiency & Decision Threshold Evaluation
nodes.rationale: Examines discrepancies theta across average and maximum market odds, demonstrating that seasonal ROI maximisation does not guarantee overall long-term profitability.

nodes.label: Temporal In-Match Causal Process
nodes.rationale: Models match outcomes through temporal order: Possession -> Shots -> Shots on Target -> Goals scored via a Beta-Binomial Hybrid BN structure.

nodes.label: Bookmaker Implied Probability Regression Model
nodes.rationale: Evaluates whether bookmakers adjust odds before a goal via 1/mintogoal alongside pre-match probabilities, time elapsed, red cards, and xG difference.

nodes.label: Continuous-Valued State-Space Model for Bettors
nodes.rationale: Employs an AR(1) latent state process with zero-one-inflated beta observation distribution to capture unobserved market activity and serial correlation in relative stakes.

nodes.label: Efficient Market Hypothesis in Sports Betting (EMH)
nodes.norm_label: efficient market hypothesis in sports betting (emh)

nodes.label: Odds-Only-Equal-Profitability-Confidence (OO-EPC) Method
nodes.rationale: Reduces inverse odds by a constant multiple of standard errors (z*sigma) to reflect the bookmaker objective of having equal confidence in profitability without needing historical data.

nodes.label: Draw Bias Phenomenon
nodes.rationale: Draw outcomes have a weaker favourite-longshot bias than decisive outcomes, causing uniform bias-adjustment methods to underestimate draw probabilities.

nodes.label: FL-GLM (Favourite-Longshot Bias Adjusted GLM)
nodes.rationale: Data-driven model to adjust for the favourite-longshot bias measured from historical betting odds.

nodes.label: Two Power Constants FL-GLM Extension
nodes.rationale: Introduces separate beta_decisive and beta_draw parameters fitted via maximum likelihood to alleviate draw bias under weaker favourite-longshot bias in draws.

nodes.label: Property 5
nodes.rationale: Proves multiplicative conversion is equivalent to FL-GLM when power constant beta is assumed to be 1.

nodes.label: Property 6
nodes.rationale: Proves power conversion is equivalent to FL-GLM when the normalisation term is assumed to be 1.

nodes.label: Proposition 7 (Log-Loss and Profitability)
nodes.rationale: Proves log-loss captures bookmakers' profitability because difference in log-loss directly derives the payout ratio u = exp(-v).

nodes.label: Multinomial Logit Regression (MLR)
nodes.rationale: Evaluated as an alternative to OLR to relax proportional odds and allow independent variables to influence draw probabilities without altering win/loss ratios.

nodes.label: Ordered Logit Regression (OLR)
nodes.rationale: Commonly used due to natural hierarchy of match outcomes (win > draw > loss), but restricted by proportional odds assumption.

nodes.label: Acceleration Index
nodes.rationale: Measures the ratio between invasion index and the square of time taken to reach the most dangerous event.

nodes.label: Invasion Index
nodes.rationale: Measures how close to the opponent's goal a team plays during possession phases based on spatial scoring probability.

nodes.label: Passing Network & Flow Centrality
nodes.rationale: Graph representation of ball passes between teammates, using betweenness and algebraic connectivity for tactical analysis.

nodes.label: Success Score DNN Predictor
nodes.rationale: 68-dimensional input architecture with 4 hidden layers (256, 128, 64, 1) and Tanh activations to predict home team Success Score.

nodes.label: Success Score Metric
nodes.rationale: Combines Expected Goals (xG) and actual goals scored via sigmoid scaling to balance chance quality and conversion efficiency while ensuring team interdependence.

nodes.label: Tactical Play Styles Framework
nodes.rationale: Categorizes 10 playing styles using FBref match metrics to inject tactical dimensions into predictive modeling.

nodes.label: Favourite-Longshot-Bias-Adjusted GLM (FL-GLM)
nodes.rationale: Fits a single power parameter beta to inverse odds with an adaptive normalization intercept, providing an interpretable quantification of favourite-longshot bias.

nodes.label: OO-EPC Method
nodes.rationale: Theoretically-driven to ensure each outcome provides the same confidence in profitability for the bookmaker without needing historical odds.
